headline: Hyulim Robot Shares Surge 30% on Samsung Electro-Mechanics Supply Agreement
summary: Shares of Hyulim Robot jumped 30% following the announcement of an equipment supply contract signed with South Korea's Samsung Electro-Mechanics.
why: Samsung Electro-Mechanics is a major component provider for smartphone, automotive, and electronics manufacturers worldwide.
